graphs.domain: all labeled simple graphs on six vertices
graphs.representation: sorted degree sequence and triangle count

set_cover.domain: five-set covering subfamilies of the 31 nonempty subsets of a five-element labeled universe

candidate_definitions.global_clause_sign_type_counts: four oriented counts (++,+-,-+,--) after orienting each clause by lower then higher variable label
candidate_definitions.labeled_signed_pair_profile: six labeled variable-pair profiles in lexicographic pair order, each with oriented bins (++,+-,-+,--)
candidate_definitions.unlabeled_signed_pair_profiles: sorted multiset of the four-bin oriented sign profile for each unordered variable pair

two_cnf.clause_enumeration: unordered literal pairs from [1,2,3,4,-1,-2,-3,-4] in combination order, excluding same-variable tautologies
two_cnf.domain: five-clause subsets of the 24 non-tautological binary clauses on four labeled variables
two_cnf.representation: signed variable occurrence counts and labeled unsigned variable-pair co-occurrence counts
two_cnf.representation_layout: positive occurrence counts for variables 1..4, then negative occurrence counts for variables 1..4; then labeled unsigned pair counts in lexicographic variable-pair order

endpoint_selection.fibre: maximum lexicographic tuple (target diameter, fibre multiplicity, repr(representation))
endpoint_selection.third_checker: recompute the selected representation and both endpoint targets with a small direct checker
endpoint_selection.witness: retain the first enumerated witness when a strict new minimum or maximum target is observed; equal-target witnesses do not replace it

target_solver_rule: two structurally different exact solvers must agree instance by instance or execution aborts
